Drive standardization and continuous improvement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), runbooks, operational workflows, and knowledge management. Improve operational efficiency through proactive problem identification, automation, and measurable improvements in incident prevention and recovery. 4. Automation and AI Transformation Define and execute an automation-first SRE strategy to eliminate repetitive manual tasks, reduce operational toil, and improve engineering productivity. Drive automation of operational workflows, maintenance activities, monitoring, health checks, diagnostics, and recovery procedures. Strengthen observability through proactive monitoring, actionable dashboards, intelligent alerting, and standardized diagnostic workflows. description: Security Engineering Depth Control and Architecture Assessment Technical Assurance and Evidence Automation, Data and Integration Independent Judgement and Communication Collaboration and Influence Senior Cyber Engineer – Governance A.P. Moller – Maersk is the global leader in integrated container logistics. The business operates in 130 countries and employs c. 100,000 staff. We Offer Maersk has established industry-leading capability in cyber resilience, even when compared to leaders within Technology and Financial Services institutions. As Senior Cyber Engineer – Governance, you will be the technical anchor for this transformation. You will work across cloud, identity, network, platforms, applications and operational technology to develop scalable assurance techniques, connect evidence from authoritative sources and automate evidence-based insight generation to inform near real-time conclusions that leaders and control owners can act on across a constantly evolving technology landscape. You will help define how Cyber Assurance is engineered at Maersk, from developing machine-testable control approaches and trusted evidence models to shaping the Assurance Engine. You will build new capabilities that combine security engineering, data, automation and assurance at global scale. This is an engineering role with a different vantage point. You will work across the control environment to validate what is effective, expose blind spots and shape how assurance is engineered at enterprise scale. This is a rare opportunity to influence how one of the world's largest logistics organisations understands, validates and continuously improves cyber control effectiveness across a global technology estate. Global integrated logistics. Secured by Maersk. What do we do? We provide the tools, expertise and governance to manage Maersk's cyber risk. Anyone can do these things. But can our competitors do them with the same level of daily excellence as Maersk? How do we do it? We proactively mitigate today’s risks, issues and events and tomorrow’s emerging threats. This is how we differentiate ourselves from our competitors – our maturity in managing risks, issues and events is hard to beat. Why do we do it? We believe in defending global integrated logistics in an increasingly hostile cyber world. This strong sense of purpose is what motivates us. It is why we insourced cyber security. Security is a passion, not a transaction to be outsourced to others. Why this job matters? We employ over 280 full-time Maersk staff in our Cyber Security organisation globally and use industry-leading cyber tooling to protect Maersk and its 100,000 employees spread across 130 countries. We continually invest in our automated defences, the skills and knowledge of our people, and process improvement, spending $70-80M annually on cyber security. In a typical week, we see 177,000 cyber events. Of these, one every 3 minutes, 24/7, is actively testing our defences. AI and automation deal with most events, but on average our in-house human defenders process 450-600 events a week. About 2 incidents a day impact one endpoint or more, which Cyber Security and Technology colleagues contain, clear and return to operation so business can carry on without wider interruption from any contagion. This is what resilience looks like – the ability of a company to continue operating through relentless attacks, some of which inevitably breach our outer defences and have to be dealt inside our technology eco-system. But all of this depends on maintaining a good security posture by understanding where we carry risk. This is where you come in – providing the evidence to inform company decision-making and to reassure our customers that they can trust us.
